messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created (ID 2955556666) - multiple container restarts observed on prod-us-west-2 serving pool. Symptom: GPU OOMs during prefill for long-context chat requests. Auto-pager triggered.
oncall-ryan: Got the page, jumping in. Which pool and models affected?
eng-runtime-maya: We're seeing restarts on pool 'serve-usw2-gpu-a'. Affected model variants: rwd-13b-qlora and rwd-7b-int8 when requests include >32k tokens prefill. Logs show repeated CudaMalloc failures.
sre-anais: Linking last few container logs: ```stderr: CUDA out of memory when allocating 2.1 GiB (total 47.8 GiB)\nstack: runtime/prefill.cpp:312 on_prefill_alloc``` Node-level memory metrics show VRAM spike then container SIGKILL.
support-lina: Customer-impact: Support queue reports ~8 users on two tenants experiencing truncated responses and reconnects since 09:12 UTC. No billing alerts yet but degraded UX.
cust-ops-omar: Which customers? Need quick customer-facing note.
eng-runtime-maya: Tenants T-Alpha and T-Beta. T-Alpha has long-chat plugin that sends full history in prefill; T-Beta has a multi-message paste flow.
oncall-ryan: Initial mitigation proposal: 1) Apply model routing fallback: route >16k prefill requests to cpu-backend or smaller quantized variant. 2) Enable prefill truncation at proxy for non-priv customers. 3) Temporarily drain most loaded nodes and spin up additional dedicated capacity if available.
eng-platform-sam: Can do route fallback and truncation rules quickly. Pushing a canary config to api-gateway now. Expected 60s to rollout.
sre-anais: Suggest also increasing eviction aggressiveness for KV cache to free GPU memory; set kvcache.max_age=30s for the pool.
incident-bot: Action assigned: eng-platform-sam -> push routing patch. eng-runtime-maya -> live triage and log capture. sre-anais -> node drain plan.
eng-runtime-maya: Added a debug trace to prefill path, grabbing stack traces on OOM. Also enabling proactive backoff for requests that exceed 24k tokens.
support-lina: Drafting customer message: "We're investigating a runtime memory issue causing intermittent disconnects for some long-chat requests in US-WEST-2. Engineers are applying mitigations now; we'll update in 30m." Want to send after initial rollback if mitigations reduce errors.
eng-platform-sam: Canary deployed routing fallback at 09:22:14 UTC. Metrics show 72% reduction in requests hitting the heavy model variants.
sre-anais: Started draining node gpu-42 and evicting non-critical pods. Observed restart count drop on that hardware.
oncall-ryan: Monitoring error rate and p50 latency. Keep me posted on any Cuda stacktraces.
eng-runtime-maya: Captured a repeatable repro: prefill size ~48k tokens from T-Alpha. Reproduction command pasted: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-13b-qlora","prefill":"<48k tokens>"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...'``` Results: CudaMalloc failed after ~1.2s.
sre-anais: Noted a pattern: concurrent interleaved streaming sessions amplify VRAM usage due to KV cache duplication. Lowering concurrent per-GPU stream limit from 12 -> 6 reduces pressure.
eng-platform-sam: Applied concurrency cap on pool at 09:28:30 UTC. We also flagged requests with prefill>24k for sampling and blocking for non-paying tiers.
cust-ops-omar: Customer update ready: "We applied routing and capacity mitigations; we're throttling extremely large history requests and will follow up with a permanent fix. ETA for full resolution 6-12 hours." Approve?
support-lina: Approve. Add note about potential follow-up CPU fallback for critical customers.
oncall-ryan: Good. Next steps: 1) Keep routing/truncation live. 2) Continue draining high-restart nodes and replace with fresh instances. 3) Postmortem to analyze KV cache duplication and consider server-side prefix compression. Assignments: eng-runtime-maya, eng-platform-sam, sre-anais. I'll take write-up.
eng-runtime-maya: Will collect heap snapshots and KV cache traces, and prepare a reproducer for the SRE runbook.
eng-platform-sam: I'll open a follow-up RFC for prefill-size-based routing and enforcement policy.
incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated (errors down to baseline 09:33:40 UTC). Pager closed but incident remains open for postmortem.
oncall-ryan: Closing page for live mitigation. We'll reconvene for the postmortem and customer RCA draft. Thanks team :thumbsup:
